skill.summary: Colorize plain text logs in your terminal with syntax highlighting for timestamps and log levels to simplify debugging.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of LogFMT CLI tool.
- Adds syntax highlighting for plain text logs in the terminal.
- Detects and colorizes timestamps and log levels (ERROR, WARN, INFO, etc.) for better readability.
- Supports reading from files, piping from other commands, and stdin.
- Priced at $2.50.
